in_sanskrit.name: गिरिजावसु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Born of Girija, the consort of Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as residing on a mountain.

in_marathi.name: Girijavasu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Derived from the mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girijavasu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Girija refers to Parvati, the daughter of the mountain king Himavat, and Vasu means 'derived from'.

in_bengali.name: Girijavasu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Derived from the mountain
in_bengali.long_meaning: Girijavasu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Girija refers to Parvati, the daughter of the mountain king Himavat, and Vasu means 'derived from'.
